verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated ISO 27001 product page claiming it helps you certify, with automated evidence collection and AI-powered ISMS templates for roles, responsibilities and risks. That points to a native framework rather than a mapping. Generic audit tooling (Auditor API, information request lists, framework-filtered evidence, framework control owners) supports certification-audit workflows, but none of it is shown to be ISO-specific. Missing for 10: explicit coverage of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation or management, ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts (e.g., Stage 1/Stage 2 deliverables, internal audit, management review), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
